description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutableSortOption class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.thingsearch package. It tests immutability, equality, string representation, and collection behaviors of ImmutableSortOption.

classes.name: ImmutableSortOptionTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ImmutableSortOption, testing various behaviors including immutability, equality, string representation, and collection handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that ImmutableSortOption instances are immutable and that SortOptionEntry objects used within are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correct implementation of equals and hashCode methods in ImmutableSortOption.

methods.name: tryToCreateNewInstanceWithNullEntries
methods.description: Ensures that passing null to ImmutableSortOption.of throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: stringRepresentationOfZeroEntriesIsExpected
methods.description: Checks that an ImmutableSortOption with no entries produces an empty string.

methods.name: stringRepresentationIsExpected
methods.description: Verifies the string output of ImmutableSortOption with specific sort entries.

methods.name: sortOptionWithoutEntriesIsEmpty
methods.description: Confirms that an ImmutableSortOption with no entries is considered empty and has size zero.

methods.name: getEntriesReturnsAnUnmodifiableCollection
methods.description: Tests that the collection returned by getEntries cannot be modified.
